MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.title: Hiro's Pen
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_PEN.flavor: The pen [color=#CC6666]Hiro[/color] often used in middle school. It should have been given to Yuki long ago
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.title: Witch Factor
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.descript: When you play an Attack card, gain 15 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. When you play a Skill or Power card, lose 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCH_FACTOR.flavor: When the witch factor becomes overactive, a person loses their sanity and turns into a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous individual that must be eliminated
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.title: What the Great Witch Once Possessed
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.description:
[color=#CC6666]「Yuki... you are wrong」[/color]
At the start of each combat, gain 6 stacks of [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color]
At the start of your turn, you may choose a card in hand to return to the draw pile
When you first gain [b]【Suspicion】[/b] this combat, lose 2 stacks
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHHIRO.flavor:
[color=#CC6666]「But... I still want to find [/color][color=#CCCCCC]you[/color][color=#CC6666]」[/color]
[color=#CC6666]「I will come find you now——to judge our [/color][b]【Crime】[/b][color=#CC6666]」[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.title: Witch Records
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.descrip: Upon obtaining, randomly generate 39 cards from the candidate witch card pool, and choose any number to add to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.flavor: A vast record of material trades between the island and the mansion, as well as intelligence on the imprisoned girls. It also contains profiles and face photos of Ema and everyone else. Deciphering it seems to take a great deal of time
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHGRIMOIRE.selecti: Choose cards to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.title: Dismantled Parts
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.descr: Each turn, gain {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}. On the first turn, automatically play all Attack cards against a random enemy.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_DISMANTLEDPARTS.flavo: Parts of a crossbow stored in a barrel in the hallway. Disassembled into pieces so small they are hard to repair
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.desc: Gain 1 ammo upon entering each node (max 6). Right-click or two-finger tap to spend 1 ammo and add a [b]【Bullet】[/b] to your hand.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICSNIPERRIFLE.flav: Maximum capacity of 6 rounds. A weapon forged with magic by a girl once held in the prison. When the date changes, 1 round is automatically loaded
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLOODIEDCLOTHING.desc: Lose 26 [b]Max HP[/b]. All Skill cards in your deck gain the [b]【Clever】[/b] enchantment.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.title: Fruit Plate of Memories
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.descriptio: Upon obtaining, choose 1 card in your deck to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.flavor: It was an afternoon long ago, the fruit plate Ema brought over
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_FRUITPLATE.selectionS: Choose 1 card to enchant with [color=#ff99cc][b]【Ema's Apple】[/b][/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.title: Safe
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.description: Upon obtaining, gain 2 random Ancient relics
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SAFE.flavor:
An opened safe.
It has a numeric keypad lock, with bloodstains on the keypad
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.des: At the start of each combat, gain 3 stacks of [b]【Crimson Butterfly】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGICALSKETCHBOOK.fla:
Anan's sketchbook.
It contains drawings of butterflies.
The artist is Noah, and the butterflies seem to be a kind of protection left for Anan
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.title: Notes
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.description: Upon obtaining, remove all [color=#CC6666]【Death Retracement】[/color] from your deck, then gain a new [color=#CC6666]【Death Retracement】[/color].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MLLNOTE.flavor: The contract reads: end the old to begin the new
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.title: Ritual Sword
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.descripti: Upon obtaining, add a [b]【Witch Repose Ritual】[/b] to your deck.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_RITUALSWORD.flavor: An elaborately decorated sword. It was previously kept in the safe. No signs of use
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.d: After ending combat, at the start of the next combat's turn, choose 3 cards to upgrade, or choose not to upgrade. For each card upgraded, lose 2 [b]Max HP[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EXTERNALINFORMATION.f: The price of information is always heavier than imagined
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.desc: When you play an Attack card, gain 15 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]. When you play a Skill or Power card, lose 10 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_WITCH_FACTOR.flav: When the witch factor becomes overactive, a person loses their sanity and turns into a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous individual that must be eliminated
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.title: A Friend's Keepsake
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.descr: At the start of combat, add [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Judge[/color][color=#6699cc]ment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] enchantments to cards based on keywords. Randomly add [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Judge[/color][color=#6699cc]ment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] components to 3 cards. Reset the enchantment counter each turn.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMA_TRIAL_BADGE.flavo: The pen left behind after [color=#CC6666]Hiro[/color] died. It holds special meaning for [color=#ff99cc]Ema[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.title: Token of Identity
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.description:
[color=#ff99cc]「But being able to reunite with Yuki now makes me truly happy」[/color]
At the [color=#ff99cc]start of turn[/color], add [color=#339966]【[/color][color=#cc9966]Judge[/color][color=#6699cc]ment[/color][color=#339966]】[/color] components to 1 card in hand and 1 in the discard pile. When [color=#ff99cc]「Closeness」[/color] and [color=#CC6666]「Distance」[/color] first reach 7, trigger an extra effect
At the [color=#ff99cc]end of turn[/color], lose 30 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b].
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITHEMA.flavor: [color=#ff99cc]「Let's go create together... a future where even the magic that kills witches no longer exists!」[/color]
Choose 5 cards from Sakuraba Ema's card pool to add to your deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_HIRO.de: Choose 5 cards from Nikaido Hiro's card pool to add to your deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_SHERRYL: Choose 5 cards from Tachibana Sherry's card pool to add to your deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_ANANLIN: Choose 5 cards from Natsume Anan's card pool to add to your deck
SEA_GLASS.MANOSABA_LIN_CHARACTER_YALISAL: Choose 5 cards from Wisteria Arisa's card pool to add to your deck
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.desc: [color=#33ccff]【Case Reversal】[/color]: When the draw pile is empty, swap cards in the exhaust pile with cards in the discard pile. For each successful swap, gain 2 stacks of [color=#33ccff]【Sherry's Magic】[/color] (cannot be gained again this combat when a card is removed; auto-removed when a Curse/Status/Ancient is exhausted)
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_MAGNIFYING_GLASS.flav: The [color=#33ccff]【Symbol】[/color] of Sherry's detective identity, but no one can guess what she saw through the 【Magnifying Glass】
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SHERRYLINS_BIRD.title: Token of Companionship
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SHERRYLINS_BIRD.descr:
[color=#33ccff]「Find the true culprit and clear Hanna's suspicion!」[/color]
At the [color=#33ccff]start of turn[/color], you may exhaust 1 card from hand, then draw 1 [color=#33ccff]card[/color]. [rainbow][b]Emotions[/b][/rainbow] now trigger every 2 [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotions】[/b][/rainbow] gained
At the [color=#33ccff]end of turn[/color], increase the [color=#33ccff]【Witchification】[/color] counter on 1 card in hand by 1
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SHERRYLINS_BIRD.flavo: [color=#33ccff]「I hate Hanna disappearing, I hate seeing Hanna worried and suffering... I hate it, hate it so much」[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_SHERRYLINS_BIRD.selec: Choose a card in hand to exhaust
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_WITCHIFICATION_EMOTIO:
When [b]【Witchification】[/b] reaches 100 stacks, gain 1 [b]【Witchification】[/b][rainbow][b]【Emotion】[/b][/rainbow] card in hand
[b][rainbow][b]【Basic Emotions】[/b][/rainbow]:[purple]【Joy】[/purple], [color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color], [color=#CC6666]【Anger】[/color], [color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color], [color=#6666cc]【Disgust】[/color], [color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color]
[color=#33ccff]Emotion Fusion Recipes[/color]:
[purple]【Joy】[/purple]+[color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color] → [color=#999999]【Melancholy】[/color]
[color=#CC6666]【Anger】[/color]+[color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff9966]【Furious Fear】[/color]
[color=#ffcc99]【Sadness】[/color]+[color=#ff99cc]【Fear】[/color] → [color=#ff0000]【Desolation】[/color]
[color=#6666cc]【Disgust】[/color]+[color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color] → [gold]【Horror Disgust】[/gold]
[purple]【Joy】[/purple]+[color=#cc9966]【Surprise】[/color] → [blue]【Elation】[/blue][/b]
6 [rainbow][b]【Basic Emotions】[/b][/rainbow]+[b][color=33ccff]【Curiosity】[/color][/b]+[green][b]【Helplessness】[/b][/green]→[b][color=#33ccff]「Friend[/color][green]ship」[/green][/b]
A witch's power comes from the [color=#ff99cc]【Emotions】[/color] within
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.title: Sherry's Chip
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.descripti:
Once per turn in a [color=#33ccff]combat room[/color], you may right-click or two-finger tap this relic to spend 10 [gold]gold[/gold] and add a random card to your hand
Outside [color=#33ccff]combat rooms[/color], spend 100 [gold]gold[/gold] to gain a random card reward
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_XUELICHOUMA.flavor: With enough luck, you may obtain an [color=#33ccff]unexpected[/color] card

Outside [color=#CC6666]combat rooms[/color], spend 100 [gold]gold[/gold] to gain a random card reward

MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMACHOUMA.description:
Once per turn in a [color=#ff99cc]combat room[/color], you may right-click or two-finger tap this relic to spend 10 [gold]gold[/gold] and add a random card to your hand
Outside [color=#ff99cc]combat rooms[/color], spend 100 [gold]gold[/gold] to gain a random card reward
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_EMACHOUMA.flavor: With enough luck, you may obtain an [color=#ff99cc]unexpected[/color] card

When the witch factor becomes overactive, a person loses their sanity and turns into a monster-like existence, regarded as a dangerous individual that must be eliminated.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_ANANS_SKETCHBOOK.desc:
When you play a Skill card, gain 2 stacks of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color]. When you play an Attack card, consume 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] and gain 1 Vigor.
At the start of each [color=#6666cc]first combat[/color], a 3-card choice appears; after choosing, record its card pool
At the start of your turn, randomly give a hand card a [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance Mark】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_ANANS_SKETCHBOOK.flav: Anan's sketchbook records other people's stories
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_ANANS_SKETCHBOOK.sele: Choose an intent to replace with Silence
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLESSED_OBJECT.title: Blessed Object
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLESSED_OBJECT.descri:
[color=#6666cc]「Noah said that butterfly drawings are the only magic she can freely paint」[/color]
The first time [color=#6666cc]this combat[/color] that [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color] or [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color] would trigger when an enemy has attack intent, gain 2 stacks of [blue]【Butterfly】[/blue] instead. Your chance of obtaining [color=#6666cc]【Pages】[/color] changes to [color=#6666cc]【Blank Pages】[/color]
At the [color=#6666cc]end of turn[/color], gain 1 stack of [color=#6666cc]【Peace of Mind】[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLESSED_OBJECT.flavor: [color=#6666cc]「Noah is amazing, exactly the scene I imagined」[/color]
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_BLESSED_OBJECT.select: Choose an intent to replace with Silence
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.de:
After you deal damage to an enemy with an Attack, consume its newest Fire Color.
When you have fewer than 13 cards in total, using a fire component additionally connects 1 random card; that card costs 0 this time, and only that random card is burned.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fl: A small thing clutched in her palm, like the last safety line not yet burned through.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALIN_WITCH_FACTO: During a run, if none of your cards is [color=#cccccc]【Witchification】[/color], add 1 [color=#cccccc]【Witchification】[/color] card to your draw pile
A factor precipitated from blood and sin, echoing softly within the body.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_YALISALINS_HAIRPIN.fi:
Each Alisa player tracks enemy Fire Color separately.
Each enemy has 6 slots: slots 1-2 are Dark Orange, 3-4 Dark Red, 5-6 Crimson. Cards give Fire Color from the lowest empty slot; Attacks consume from the newest slot.
Consuming the same color twice in a row triggers that color's Chain effect.
[color=#ff0000]Stoke[/color]: give Fire Color; any excess over 6 immediately triggers the consume effects of the matching slots. Continued excess keeps resolving (cycling every 6 slots), and adjacent same colors can still chain.
When consuming dark-orange fire: each stage grants 4 Block. For every 2 dark-orange stages consumed, draw 1 card.

When consuming dark-red fire: each stage makes the next non-X card cost 1 less this time and grants 1 stack of next-turn energy. Next-turn energy gained this way is capped per turn at the current energy cap. For every 2 dark-red stages consumed, immediately gain 1 energy.

When consuming crimson fire: each stage deals {Damage} damage to a random enemy and grants equal Alisa's Magic, then crimson damage +1. For every 2 crimson stages consumed, deal an extra 2nd-stage crimson damage and gain 1 Strength.
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_DECK_CLEANSER: At the start of each turn, you may put any number of cards from your hand, [color=#CC6666]draw pile[/color], [color=#CC6666]discard pile[/color] or [color=#CC6666]exhaust pile[/color] into your [color=#CC6666]discard pile[/color]
Choose any number of cards to discard
"Empty the clutter from your mind — only then do you truly hold the power."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_EMOTION_OVERF:
When your orb slots are full—
[color=#ffcc99]Ongoing[/color] (Sadness / Anger / Joy / Melancholy / Elation / Curiosity / Friendship): leaves its orb slot and hangs below your HP bar instead, working on its own until the start of your next turn.
[color=#6666cc]Disgust[/color] / [gold]Horror Disgust[/gold]: every enemy that intends to attack hits you once with its own attack (its intent is unchanged), then the reflect resolves and you heal for the same amount.
[color=#ff99cc]Delayed[/color] (Fear / Surprise / Irritated Fear / Desolate / Helplessness): pays out its delayed value immediately when squeezed out.
"Emotions never vanish. They simply move to a new home."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_WITCHIFICATIO:
When the [color=33ccff][b]Witchification[/b][/color] count increases by 1, immediately gain 20 stacks of [b]【Witchification】[/b].
At [color=CC6666]start of turn[/color], if [b]【Witchification】[/b] is above 300 it drops to 100; every 25 stacks removed becomes 1 [color=33ccff][b]Witchification[/b][/color] count, added to cards carrying a [color=33ccff][b]Witchification[/b][/color] component.
"The more active the factor, the further reason drifts away."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_TRANSMIGRATIO: When you play a [color=#CC6666]【Reincarnation】[/color] card, instead automatically play 2 random [color=#CC6666]【Reincarnation】[/color] cards from your [color=#CC6666]draw pile[/color].
"Walk the same road twice, and you leave with two different endings."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_PERJURY_PAYME:
When you do not have enough [color=#CC6666]energy[/color], you may spend 3 [color=#CC6666]【Perjury】[/color] per missing energy in its place.
During this, each 1 [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color] is automatically converted into 4 [color=#CC6666]【Perjury】[/color].
"Out of energy? Fill the gap with lies."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_JUSTICE_REGEN:
At the [color=CC6666]end of your turn[/color], if your [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color] stacks exceed your [b]Regen[/b], [b]Regen[/b] is raised to match your [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color].
Your [color=#CC6666]【Justice】[/color] no longer heals you.
"Justice no longer mends wounds — it leaves only hope of equal weight."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_COLORLESS_PAG: Your [color=#6666cc]【Blank Page】[/color] and [color=#6666cc]【Margin Page】[/color] gain one extra option: a [b]colorless card[/b] you can play [b]for free[/b] this turn.
"Between the lines, a sentence no one wrote."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_PEACE_OF_MIND:
When you play a card, gain an extra effect based on your current [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color]:
[b]Attack[/b]: gain that much [b]Vigor[/b].
[b]Skill[/b]: gain that much [b]Block[/b].
[b]Power[/b]: spend all [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color], gain that many [color=#6666cc]【Margin Pages】[/color], then gain 3 [color=#6666cc]【Reassurance】[/color].
"Once the mind is still, the pen moves on its own."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_BRAINWASH_RES:
[color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color] now uses the growing replacement-intent pool of [color=#6666cc]【Silence】[/color], sharing the very same pool.
The first [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash】[/color] of each combat grants no [color=#6666cc]【Brainwash Backlash】[/color].
"What is spoken and what is swallowed come from the same well."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_WITCH_FACTOR_: At the start of the [color=CC6666]enemy turn[/color], every enemy carrying [color=#CC6666]【Witch Factor】[/color] takes [color=#CC6666]damage equal to its own stacks[/color].
"The factor churns within and carves every layer into flesh."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_TRIAL_EMBODIM: When your card [color=#CC6666]gains an enchantment[/color], it is [color=#CC6666]embodied[/color] into the card (not occupying the enchantment slot; its name is shown on the card, its effect appears on hover, and it triggers alongside the card when played). A card can therefore hold several [color=#CC6666]differently-named[/color] enchantments at once. The [color=#CC6666]same enchantment[/color] can only exist once and cannot stack.
"A verdict need not be written on paper; it grows straight into the card."
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_BOND_DRIFT.de:
When [color=#ff99cc]【Affinity】[/color] increases your model moves [color=#CC6666]left[/color]; when [color=#CC6666]【Estrangement】[/color] increases it moves [color=#CC6666]right[/color]; when either decreases it moves the opposite way. The offset accumulates and never resets on its own.
On moving [color=#CC6666]left[/color]: every teammate (excluding yourself) gains one [color=#CC6666]【Multiplayer】[/color] card from their own pool.
On moving [color=#CC6666]right[/color]: randomly remove one [color=#CC6666]【Multiplayer】[/color] card from all teammates' cards; on success, its owner's next [color=#CC6666]【Multiplayer】[/color] card costs 1 less (stackable, all removed once a multiplayer card is played).
MANOSABA_LIN_RELIC_HEXTECH_BOND_DRIFT.fl: "Step closer and your feet drift left; pull away and your shadow drifts right."
